category: S3-compatible object storage, instant-access archive class in 3-AZ regions

free_tier.stated: No free tier: the Active Archive class in a 3-AZ (Multi Zone) region is billed from the first GiB at USD 0.00000729 per GiB-hour (about USD 0.0053217 per GiB-month), with a 90-day minimum storage duration and USD 0.0212 per GiB retrieved
free_tier.notes: billed per GiB-hour; the monthly figure is the hourly price x 730 hours

per_object_cap.stated: 48 TiB per object through multipart upload; 5 GiB through a single PUT
per_object_cap.notes: the Object Storage technical limits page states one set of limits for the Object Storage offer

retention.stated: unlimited volume and time; each object is billed for a minimum of 2,190 hours (90 days), and an object deleted or moved to another class earlier is charged for the remaining hours
retention.notes: a billing minimum, not a deletion clock

egress.terms: External ingoing and outgoing traffic, internal traffic and API requests are free; reading data back costs USD 0.0212 per GiB retrieved, counted on get-object requests, and the object stays instantly readable
egress.price_per_tb: USD 19.74 per TB retrieved (USD 0.0212 per GiB x 931.32 GiB per TB)

tooling: AWS CLI, rclone, s3cmd, any S3 SDK; lifecycle rules move objects between classes
chaining: S3 origin behind a CDN or proxy; lifecycle rules move objects between this class and the Standard class

limits.value: 48 TiB per object by multipart upload; 5 GiB by a single PUT
300 PUT and 900 GET requests per second per bucket, soft defaults

limits_note: Available only in the 3-AZ regions Paris and Milan: 99.99% availability SLA; a retrieval fee and a 90-day minimum storage duration apply
binding_note: none: storage has no stated cap, an object may reach 48 TiB, the per-bucket rates are soft defaults, and the 90-day minimum storage duration and the USD 0.0212 per GiB retrieval fee are billing terms, not limits

identity_cost.detail: an email address validated by a one-time code, the country of tax residence, and a valid payment method on the account before the first Public Cloud project

reliability_note: 99.99% availability SLA, 3-AZ regions only; durability is stated as 11 nines for every class
confidence_note: documented: the international price list, the storage classes pages, the endpoints page and the technical limits page were read and quoted on 2026-11-03; a read timed from a bucket would make it measured

evidence.quote: | Active Archive | - | Free | Free | $0.0212 | Free | 90 days | $0.00000729 | ~$0.0053217 |
evidence.proved: the Active Archive class costs USD 0.00000729 per GiB-hour, about USD 0.0053217 per GiB-month, with a 90-day minimum, USD 0.0212 per GiB retrieved, and free traffic and API requests

evidence.quote: For optimal readability, the price is displayed as GiB/month – but since there are 730 hours in an average month, the invoicing granularity is GiB/hour.
evidence.proved: Object Storage is invoiced per GiB-hour and the monthly figure assumes 730 hours

evidence.quote: A minimum storage duration applies to cold storage classes: 730 hours (30 days) for Infrequent Access, 2,190 hours (90 days) for Active Archive and 4,380 hours (180 days) for Cold Archive.
evidence.proved: the minimum storage durations are 30 days for Infrequent Access and 90 days for Active Archive, and an early delete is charged for the remaining hours

evidence.quote: | Active Archive | Long-term regulatory data storage, disaster recovery plans | milliseconds | 3-AZ | 3-AZ regions: 99.99% | 90 days | Yes | Object-level, lifecycle management support |
evidence.proved: Active Archive is a 3-AZ-only class with millisecond first-byte time, a 99.99% SLA, a 90-day minimum and a retrieval fee

evidence.quote: | Paris | eu-west-par | HTTPS | 4 | 3-AZ region | Standard, Infrequent Access, Active Archive and Cold Archive |
evidence.proved: the Paris 3-AZ region supports the Active Archive class

evidence.quote: | Milan | eu-south-mil | HTTPS | 4 | 3-AZ region | Standard, Infrequent Access and Active Archive |
evidence.proved: the Milan 3-AZ region supports the Active Archive class
Active Archive is offered in the 3-AZ Paris and 3-AZ Milan regions and in no other European region

evidence.quote: | Maximum Object size | 48 TiB | This maximum can be achieved using Multi-Part Upload (MPU), via a single PUT request, the maximum object size is 5 GiB |
evidence.proved: the largest object is 48 TiB by multipart upload and 5 GiB by a single PUT
Object Storage bandwidth is 1 Gbps per connection, lifted by parallel requests
the default write rate is 300 requests per second on a bucket, a soft limit

evidence.quote: You need to add a valid payment method to your OVHcloud customer account before starting the free trial, which will be used after your free trial ends, if you want to keep running the project you have launched.
evidence.proved: a valid payment method is required on the account before the first Public Cloud project

evidence.quote: After you submit this form, a one-time code will be sent to the email address you entered.
evidence.proved: account creation validates the email address with a one-time code

price_per_tb_month: USD 4.96 per TB per month (USD 0.0053217 per GiB-month x 931.32 GiB per TB), plus USD 19.74 per TB retrieved; 90-day minimum
notes: offered only in 3-AZ Paris (eu-west-par) and 3-AZ Milan (eu-south-mil); objects stay instantly readable, unlike Cold Archive, which needs a restore first
